responsibility: This file implements the out-of-line parts of GCC’s shared fixed-size memory block pool used by pool allocators and obstacks. It defines the singleton memory_block_pool instance, trims the freelist back to a requested number of cached blocks, and provides obstack chunk allocate/free hooks that route 64KB-sized chunks through the shared pool while falling back to direct heap allocation for other sizes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/memory-block.h, which defines the pool class and inline allocate/release operations, this .cc file supplies the out-of-line singleton storage, freelist trimming logic, and obstack chunk allocation/free hooks.
